args.intent: orders table amount completed orders gross revenue

args.content: Working definition: 'settlement total' = gross revenue, computed as SUM(amount) over completed orders (order status = completed), restricted to calendar Q4 2025 (October 1 through December 31, 2025 / order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31'). This is gross revenue and does NOT subtract discount (unlike the general 'Revenue' definition in the Revenue Reporting Policy, which is amount - discount). Note this differs from the 'closeout total' definition (same gross-revenue formula but scoped to December 2025 only). Use this exact definition for any 'settlement total' analysis in future sessions: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM memory.bench.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31'.
